summary: Treat nested message MIME parts as attachment boundaries even when filename and Content-Disposition metadata are absent.
decision_refs: The active goal requires better RFI, Submittal and Email accuracy and adaptability
FR-PARSE-007 forbids attached-email bodies from entering parent evidence before explicit import
Offline reproduction showed an unmarked message/rfc822 question changing a parent RFI response to MIXED
approval_evidence: The persistent user goal explicitly requires continued accuracy and adaptability improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
known_limitations: Nested message content remains inert until a reviewer explicitly imports it; automatic recursion is not added.
The generated fallback name identifies an unnamed attached email but does not infer an original filename.
Other unsupported or malformed non-message MIME parts retain existing behavior.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no customer email, mailbox or provider API is used.
